statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope attributed to sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
The service is ordered to evaluate the efficacy of current rate-control management
The diagnoses addressed are I49.5 and G45.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
